content_sections.heading: Detailed Job Descriptions
content_sections.text: Supports Bank of Baroda's receivable management and recovery operations through field visits and customer interactions for timely recovery of overdue payments, in compliance with RBI guidelines and the Fair Practices Code. Responsibilities include visiting allocated customers, negotiating repayment plans, resolving queries, maintaining records, escalating disputed cases, and achieving monthly productivity/recovery/quality targets. Possession of a two-wheeler and valid driving licence is required. Job location: PAN India. Assists walk-in branch customers in adopting the Bank's digital banking ecosystem — mobile banking, internet banking, UPI, and digital applications for FDs, RDs, loans, insurance, investment products, and credit cards. Also supports digital service requests (KYC updates, cheque books, nominee updates, etc.). This is a part-time role (6 hours, 10:30 AM–4:30 PM), open to freshers. Job location: PAN India. Performs Aadhaar enrolment and update processes, captures biometric data (fingerprints, iris scan, photograph), verifies identity documents, enters demographic details as per UIDAI standards, and maintains data privacy. Requires an active NSEIT certificate and basic computer/typing skills. Job location: PAN India, including AEC centres and enrolment camps. The job description document details a related "Executive – Debit Card Operations (Issuance/Reconciliation/Disputes)" profile under Digital Banking at Vadodara, matching the notice's separate Debit Card Operations role (10 posts). No separate detailed JD was found for the "Executive – ATM/Reconciliation/Complaints/Debit Cards" role (40 posts, Alkapuri, Vadodara) listed in the notice. Covers day-to-day sales management for Home/Auto/Education/Tractor loans, including empanelling and developing sales teams, achieving sales/cross-sell targets through SO/SSO and dealer channels, managing client relationships, and ensuring compliance with NHB/RBI regulations. A Graduate degree is mandatory; minimum 3 years of relevant experience (ASM level) or 1–3 years (Direct Sales Executive level). Job location: PAN India, including Mumbai, Bengaluru, NCR, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, and Baroda. Manages large volumes of outbound calls for overdue payment collection, following communication scripts, identifying customer needs, and meeting individual/team collection targets. DRA certification is required; candidates should not be pursuing further studies. Experience required: minimum 0–5 years (varies by seniority — Executive/Senior Executive, Assistant Manager, or Trainer-level roles have differing experience requirements as detailed in the source JDs). Locations: GIFT City-Gandhinagar, Vadodara, Bangalore, and Manjalpur-Vadodara depending on the specific sub-role. Manages data for client reporting, dashboards (daily/weekly/monthly), campaign and dialer data management, automation of reports, and statistical/performance feedback to operations. faq.question: Q1. What is BGSSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BGSSL Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive by Baroda Global Shared Services Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Bank of Baroda, for 18 job roles across Collections, Digital Banking, Retail Sales, HR, IT, Trade Finance, and Aadhaar Operations at various locations in India.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BGSSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As per the recruitment notice, a total of 1,949 open positions are available across 18 job roles, ranging from single-post roles like Procurement Manager and Desktop Support Analyst to large-scale roles like Field Collection Officers (400), Digital Onboarding Specialist (400), and Aadhaar Operator (400).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BGSSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for application is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for BGSSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by role- ranging from a minimum HSC/12th Pass (e.g., Aadhaar Operator, Field Collection Officers) to a Graduate degree (e.g., Sales Officer/ASM, Procurement Manager) and Postgraduate/MBA preference for some managerial roles. See the role-wise eligibility table above for details.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for BGSSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply directly through the BGSSL Career Page at www.bgss.in/careers or by emailing their resume to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. Which locations are hiring under BGSSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: GIFT City-Gandhinagar, Vadodara (including Alkapuri and Manjalpur), Bangalore, Jogeshwari-Mumbai, and PAN India (for Field Collection Officers, Digital Onboarding Specialist, Sales Officer/ASM/RSM, and Aadhaar Operator roles).

faq.question: Q7. Is there any preference given in BGSSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to Agniveers and to women returning to the workforce after a career break, provided they meet the prescribed eligibility criteria for the role.
